'''Rampart Armor''' is a {{Rare}} [[Armor]] set. It is obtained from the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}.

== Obtaining ==
=== Mob Drops ===
Pieces of '''Rampart Armor''' have a chance to be dropped from mobs in the {{Zone|Stronghold}} and {{Zone|Crimson Fields}} on the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}}.
{{Drop Sources|Rampart Armor Piece}}

== Trivia ==
* '''Rampart Armor''' can be seen as the {{Zone|Crimson Isle}} counter part to {{Item|Arachne's Armor}} or {{Item|Ender Armor}}, though it lacks equipment.
* '''Rampart Armor''' can be salvaged for {{Item|Crimson Essence|amount=5}} per piece.
